scenes.setting: Still at breakfast: certain this was Mr. Fool's adorer, Audrey plans an afternoon tea party — invitations via Annie to Glaint, Kance and friends — so others will ask MI9's questions for her; matured past taking 'punishing evil' at face value, she suspects a deeper factor behind Capim
scenes.text_anchor: I hope Kance can provide some useful information

scenes.setting: Jam bread and the morning paper: 'What? A safe?' — the investigators pocketed Capim's valuables and pinned it on the Hero Bandit ('I like that name…'); then a deliberately visible day of detective theater at Broken Axe Lane, still 'investigating' Daisy's disappearance
scenes.text_anchor: Hero Bandit Dark Emperor… I like that name…

scenes.setting: Nine a.m., the shabby apartment: Daisy home under police escort — Freja darts through the hanging laundry to hug her; tears, then straight back to washing; over black bread Daisy describes the figure on the roof in black armor and crown: 'A hero!'
A secret chamber compares Lanevus and Capim: two different perpetrators, both leaving tarot cards — either a copycat, or 'an organization symbolized by tarot cards!'
